name: 轻量透气百搭跑步鞋款
description: 轻量透气鞋面、软弹厚底、百搭系带跑步鞋

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and infographic screens, light warm-grey studio surface #E8E6E2 for macro and CTA shots, soft off-white panel #F5F3EF for trust screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft diffused front-left key with fill, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light warm-grey seamless studio surface #E8E6E2
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines; short labels set in near-black #1C1C1C or reversed white on solid near-black label blocks
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single near-black color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set; product always grounded with a contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal monochrome sports-shoe ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, light warm-grey studio surface #E8E6E2, soft off-white panel #F5F3EF, near-black text and label blocks #1C1C1C, and one product-matched accent color #1C1C1C; bright even high-key studio lighting with soft diffused front-left key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; solid near-black rectangular label blocks with reversed white text; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; clean breathing margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front angle, eye-level, one shoe stepped in front of the other, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A pair of shoes shown at a slight 3/4 front angle, eye-level, one shoe stepped in front of the other, full product visible and centered. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the shoes. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product fills 60-70% of the frame with even breathing margins around the pair. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no feet, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand markings, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达轻量透气的核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile, shoe at the lower center of the frame
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft contact shadow
shots.background: pure white #FFFFFF with one solid near-black rectangular label block #1C1C1C
shots.textZone: top area: one solid near-black #1C1C1C label block with a short reversed-white headline 「{selling_point_1}」, one smaller subline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1C below it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One shoe shown in a clean 90-degree side profile at the lower center of the frame, filling 50-60% of the frame with the sole line running level. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft contact shadow. Pure white background #FFFFFF with one solid near-black rectangular label block #1C1C1C at the top carrying a short reversed-white headline 「{selling_point_1}」, and one smaller subline label 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1C below it, the label block anchoring the upper third of the composition. Negative: no more than one claim, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand markings, no props covering the product, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 用环形布局集中讲清 3-4 个核心卖点，消除选购疑虑
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down, pair centered inside a thin circular ring diagram
shots.lighting: bright even studio lighting, soft contact shadow, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: 3-4 thin-line circular feature nodes around the product, each with a short label and a thin-line icon in #1C1C1C, connected to the ring by thin leader lines
shots.textZone: one headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1C at the top; one short feature label per node 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic of {product} in a circular feature layout. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pair photographed at a high 45-degree angle looking down, centered inside a thin circular ring, with three or four thin-line circular feature nodes around it connected by thin leader lines, each node carrying a short label and a thin-line icon in #1C1C1C. Bright even studio lighting, soft contact shadow. Pure white background #FFFFFF. One headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1C at the top and one short feature label per node 「{selling_point_1}」「{selling_point_2}」「{selling_point_3}」. The product and ring diagram together fill 60-70% of the frame with the layout kept even and readable. Negative: no dense body text, no invented material claims, no unreadable tiny text, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand markings.

shots.intent: 展示多色可选并给出一目了然的尺码对照，消除选码疑虑
shots.camera: three colorway variants in one row, each straight-on at a consistent front 3/4 angle, identical framing across variants
shots.lighting: even high-key studio lighting, identical across all variants, soft contact shadows
shots.props: one compact size-table strip below the variants with generic column headers and short example values
shots.textZone: one color-name label per variant 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 in #1C1C1C, plus a size-table strip with generic column headers 「{callout_1}」 and short example values
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three colorway variants of the same shoe shown straight-on at a consistent front 3/4 angle in one row, identical lighting across all variants, each variant color accurately matched to its own reference. Even high-key studio lighting, soft contact shadows. Pure white background #FFFFFF. One color-name label per variant 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 in #1C1C1C, and below the row a compact size-table strip with generic column headers 「{callout_1}」 and a few short example values in #1C1C1C separated by thin rules. The variants and table together fill 60-70% of the frame with even margins around the grid. Negative: no mixed lighting between variants, no invented size numbers, no texture loss on dark colorways, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand markings.

shots.intent: 微距证明鞋面编织质感与透气细节
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, high 60-degree angle looking down on the woven upper and lacing area, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing the knit texture, controlled highlight
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the woven upper texture and lacing area. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 60-degree angle looking down, shallow depth of field with the foreground threads sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the knit texture. Light warm-grey studio surface background #E8E6E2. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, the weave texture is the whole point of the shot. One small label 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1C1C1C tucked into a corner. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented material claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand markings, no extra props.

shots.intent: 低角度微距展示鞋底纹路与中底厚度，证明软弹缓震
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a very low angle looking upward at the toe tip, outsole tread and midsole edge filling the frame, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft directional side light revealing the tread pattern, gentle highlight on the midsole
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the outsole tread and midsole edge at the toe. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward at the front tip, shallow depth of field. Soft directional side light revealing the tread pattern with a gentle highlight on the midsole. Light warm-grey studio surface background #E8E6E2. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, the tread and midsole thickness are the whole point of the shot. One short label 「{selling_point_2}」 in #1C1C1C tucked into a corner. Negative: no blurry subject, no floating product, no invented grip data, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand markings.

shots.intent: 用鞋后跟包边与车线等可验证实拍细节呈现做工，降低购买顾虑
shots.camera: mid shot from a 3/4 rear-side angle showing the heel counter, product placed on the left
shots.lighting: even clean high-key studio light, soft contact shadow
shots.props: right side a clean text column with two thin-line icon rows (heel and stitching icons in #1C1C1C) pointing at the visible heel counter details
shots.textZone: one headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1C and two trust labels 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in the right column
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Mid shot of the shoe from a 3/4 rear-side angle showing the heel counter and its stitching, placed on the left and filling 65-75% of the frame; on the right a clean text column with two thin-line icon rows (heel and stitching icons in #1C1C1C), thin leader lines pointing at the visible heel counter details. Even clean high-key studio light, soft contact shadow. Soft off-white panel background #F5F3EF. A short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1C with two trust labels 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 in the right column, each tied to a detail actually visible in the photo. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, or test data; no fabricated badges, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand markings, no dense body text.

shots.intent: 低角度张力特写收口，实色促单按钮收束视线促成加购
shots.camera: dramatic very low angle close-up of the toe and lacing from the front, slight dynamic tilt, product in the lower half of the frame
shots.lighting: punchier soft studio light from the upper left, clear contact shadow
shots.props: one solid near-black rounded CTA button
shots.textZone: one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1C on a clean upper area, and one solid near-black #1C1C1C rounded CTA button 「{callout_2}」 with reversed white text
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Dramatic very low angle close-up of the toe and lacing from the front with a slight dynamic tilt, product filling 65-75% of the frame in the lower half. Punchier soft studio light from the upper left, clear contact shadow. Light warm-grey studio surface background #E8E6E2. A short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1C on a clean upper area, and one solid near-black #1C1C1C rounded CTA button 「{callout_2}」 with reversed white text placed under the headline, its solid fill standing out against the light surface. Negative: no invented discounts or claims, no countdown elements, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand markings, no extra text.

provenance.notes: 从 8 张跑步鞋爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌三道杠鞋身标识、全部原文案（标题/卖点/尺码数字/型号/会员促销角标）与配色绑定，产品一律以 {product} 占位，颜色以生成时 hex 锁定；信任与尺码信息以可验证的工艺细节和通用表头呈现，不虚构认证与检测数据。
